aggregation_precedence.candidate_profile_total: Compute from the eight governed season component fields; this is the only exact tiber-generic-full-ppr-v1 value.
aggregation_precedence.promoted_source_total: Preserve production_summary.season_ppr as a comparator; never overwrite it or treat it as profile-equivalent when it mismatches.
aggregation_precedence.weekly_total: No weekly scoring rows exist in the promoted source. Do not fabricate a weekly sum or use an unpinned weekly artifact as a substitute.

allowed: use derived_generic_ppr as candidate evidence after downstream admission
inspect source-total discrepancies and explicit completeness
not_allowed: rewrite promoted source bytes or totals
infer omitted source-total components per row
claim every source season_ppr conforms to the candidate profile
authorize Forecast model admission, cutoff selection, or run execution
promote, deploy, rank, advise, or produce league-specific scoring

missingness_and_zero.genuine_zero: A present numeric 0 is a governed observed zero and participates in the score; it is listed in observed_zero_components.
missingness_and_zero.source_total_unavailable: A missing/null production_summary.season_ppr yields source_total_missing and is not reconstructed.
missingness_and_zero.unavailable: A missing key or JSON null is unavailable, remains null, and yields component_missing; no unavailable component is zero-filled.

numeric_rule.arithmetic: base-10 Decimal constructed from JSON numeric text
numeric_rule.comparison: Quantize component-derived and source totals independently to 0.01, then compare the cent-scale values. Raw decimal values/deltas remain visible as diagnostics but never drive semantic status.
numeric_rule.component_input_type: finite integer-valued JSON numbers; strings and booleans are rejected
numeric_rule.source_total_input_type: finite JSON number; strings and booleans are rejected
numeric_rule.within_tolerance: Reserved state; v1 tolerance is 0.00, so no nonzero cent-scale delta qualifies.

profile.canonical_json_rule: UTF-8 JSON; object keys sorted recursively; separators ',' and ':'; no insignificant whitespace; profile_sha256 is SHA-256 over the canonical JSON bytes of profile.definition only

ordered_precedence.condition: player_id/player_name is missing or identity_confidence is not source_verified
season is outside 2021-2025, season_type is not REG, or season completeness is irreconcilable
one or more governed component paths is null or absent
signed cent-scale delta is nonzero and absolute delta is at most tolerance; reserved and unreachable while tolerance is 0.00

fixed.candidate_profile_matches_source_total_a: Independently normalized candidate and source totals match exactly.
fixed.candidate_profile_within_declared_numeri: A nonzero normalized delta is no greater than tolerance.
fixed.coverage_status_conflicts_with_weeks_obs: Declared coverage_status disagrees with deterministic classification.
fixed.delta_not_attributable_from_promoted_com: Promoted rows omit the out-of-profile fields needed for per-row attribution.
fixed.position_outside_qb_rb_wr_te_scope: Producer-native position is outside the approved profile.
fixed.required_profile_component_unavailable: One or more exact source paths in component_bindings is absent or null.
fixed.season_or_season_type_outside_contract: season is outside 2021-2025 or season_type is not REG.
fixed.source_total_not_equivalent_to_candidate: The normalized source total differs from the candidate profile total.
fixed.source_verified_identity_required: A nonempty player ID/name and source_verified confidence are required.
fixed.weeks_observed_not_integer: weeks_observed is not a non-boolean JSON integer.
fixed.weeks_observed_outside_0_18: weeks_observed is outside the inclusive range 0-18.
fixed.zero_regular_season_weeks_observed: No regular-season stat-line week is represented.

patterns.computed_<season_completeness>: Carries the deterministic completeness class on a conflict.
patterns.declared_<coverage_status>: Carries the producer-declared coverage_status value on a conflict.

reconciliation_status_contract.selection_rule: Evaluate ordered_precedence from lowest order to highest and emit the first matching status. The final three delta states apply only after all eligibility, completeness, component, and source-total conditions pass.

status_definitions.component_missing: At least one governed component path is absent or null; no component is inferred or zero-filled.
status_definitions.identity_unresolved: Source-verified player identity is not established.
status_definitions.reconciled_exact: All higher-precedence gates pass and candidate/source totals match after independent cent-scale normalization.
status_definitions.reconciled_within_tolerance: All higher-precedence gates pass and a nonzero normalized delta is within tolerance; reserved in v1 because tolerance is 0.00.
status_definitions.regular_season_scope_unresolved: Season/season_type or deterministic completeness evidence does not satisfy the governed regular-season scope.
status_definitions.scoring_mismatch: All higher-precedence gates pass and the normalized delta is nonzero and outside tolerance.
status_definitions.season_incomplete: The row declares zero observed regular-season weeks.
status_definitions.source_total_missing: The promoted comparator total is absent or null.
status_definitions.unsupported_position: The producer-native position is outside QB/RB/WR/TE.

reconciliation_status_contract.validation_precondition: Before status selection, governed component and source-total values must satisfy numeric_rule. A malformed numeric type, non-finite value, or non-integral component is a build-stopping contract violation; it is not converted into a row status.

season_completeness.full_season: 15-18 distinct REG week numbers with a stat line
season_completeness.irreconcilable: non-integer/out-of-range weeks_observed or declared coverage_status conflicting with the deterministic count rule
season_completeness.non_inference: A missing stat-line week is not interpreted as a missed game, injury, inactive status, or roster absence.
season_completeness.partial_season: 2-14 distinct REG week numbers with a stat line
season_completeness.single_week: exactly 1 distinct REG week number with a stat line

source_scope.origin_boundary: Season presence and scoring identity only; this evidence does not define, execute, or accept any Forecast split.

source_total_semantics.interpretation_rule: A nonzero delta is preserved as scoring_mismatch. The promoted artifact does not expose the out-of-profile component families, so the net delta must not be reverse-engineered or attributed per row.
source_total_semantics.promoted_builder_declaration: nflreadpy.load_player_stats(summary_level='reg').fantasy_points_ppr is passed through directly from the nflverse season rollup

semantic_corroboration.provenance_limit: Current official producer code corroborates field semantics but is not claimed as the exact historical nflreadpy/nflverse release used to create the promoted source; that release was not pinned.

week_inclusion.malformed_or_out_of_scope_rule: A row whose season_type is not REG, whose season is outside 2021-2025, or whose weeks_observed is outside 0-18 is regular_season_scope_unresolved and is not silently scored as valid.
week_inclusion.source_limitation: Promoted rows expose weeks_observed counts, not individual week numbers. This evidence binds the declared REG aggregation and count range; it does not invent or independently reconstruct per-week rows.
